title: KHR_character_expression_mapping glTF Document Extension
description: Maps inputs from external expression vocabularies to native expression drivers.

expressionSetMappings.description: Nonempty dictionary of mapping sets from external expression inputs to native expression drivers. Each key identifies one external vocabulary.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty dictionary of input expression keys. Each value lists weighted contributions from that input to native expression drivers.
Nonempty array of contributions from this input to native expression drivers.

items.description: Weighted contribution from an external expression input to a native expression driver.

source.description: Index of the native expression to drive in the top-level KHR_character_expression expressions array.
source.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.description: Optional name of this mapping entry.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: This name is independent of the referenced expression entry's name. Resolution MUST use `source`, not this value.

weight.description: Contribution coefficient from this external input to the referenced native expression driver.
